headline: Trigyn Technologies shifts registered office within Mumbai

modes.bear: Merely a clerical update with no bearing on the company's financial health or earnings.
modes.bull: A routine corporate relocation showing ongoing operational continuity within the same business hub.
modes.simple: The company has simply moved its office desk location to a different unit within the same tech park in Mumbai.

summary: Trigyn Technologies Limited has changed its registered office address within Mumbai. The new address is located at Unit No. 404, NEST 02, SEEPZ, Andheri (East), Mumbai 400096, moving from its previous location at SDF-I in the same SEEPZ-SEZ area. The company formally notified the stock exchange regarding this administrative update. This procedural corporate relocation has no financial impact on the business or its shareholders.
why_it_matters: Purely administrative office shift with zero financial impact.
